rule: Development and Production use the same governed source contract; environment-specific secrets and activation state remain separate.
evidenceBoundary: Source-package presence is verified here; live production deployment health/credentials require deployment-specific evidence.

persistenceIsolation.rule: Development and Production default durable persistence paths are environment-scoped and must not share the same database file.
persistenceIsolation.override: KV_DATABASE_PATH may override the default only when deployment configuration explicitly provisions the environment-specific path.

platformSourceContract: Website + Desktop/PWA + Android + iOS use the same governed backend/source-of-truth contract.
